summary: Implemented GeneralizedWassersteinDiceLoss in monai/losses/dice.py (after GeneralizedDiceLoss, before the alias block), added the generalized_wasserstein_dice alias, exported the class from monai/losses/__init__.py, and added tests/test_generalized_wasserstein_dice_loss.py with the binary 2D and empty class cases. Nothing was run: per instructions, tests and repository code were not executed, so verification is by reading only. Cross-sample TP/D is computed by broadcasting (batch, 1, N) against (1, batch, N); by hand the batch-of-two example gives TP 0.8, D 2.4, loss 0.333. Changes are uncommitted.
